def solve(a):
    a=np.array(a); H,W=a.shape
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(a.flatten())
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # neighbor stats per color
    has_nb={}
    for v in cnt:
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if a[r,c]==v]
        k=sum(1 for r,c in cells if any(0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W and a[r+dr,c+dc]==v for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))))
        has_nb[v]=k/len(cells) if cells else 0
    shape_colors=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg and has_nb[v]>=0.5]
    noise=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if a[r,c]!=bg and a[r,c] not in shape_colors]
    out=a.copy()
    for r,c in noise: out[r,c]=-1
    for color in shape_colors:
        lab,n=ndimage.label(out==color)
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
            r0,r1,c0,c1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
            sub=out[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]
            if np.all((sub==color)|(sub==-1)):
                sub[sub==-1]=color
    out[out==-1]=bg
    return out
